evidence: Modifies core validation APIs in src/validation.h and src/consensus/validation.h, changing block validation methods to return BlockValidationState directly.
rationale: Eliminating boolean out-parameter validation signatures retires an interface hazard where the boolean return and internal state could become inconsistent. As the author notes, out-parameters create 'the potentially inconsistent case when the bool return value and the returned state are inconsistent' and 'unintuitive interaction between subsequent calls with the same state.' It is a clean internal refactor that improves validation interface ergonomics without changing consensus rules or validation behavior.
